id.description:
Row UUID.

Note:
This is a Primary Key.<pk/>

source.description: Evidence source identifier (currently oecd: the OECD.AI Policy Navigator / GAIIN).

external_id.description: Record id within the evidence source; unique per source.

country_id.description:
FK to countries.id; null when the jurisdiction is not a dataset country.

Note:
This is a Foreign Key to `countries.id`.<fk table='countries' column='id'/>

country_raw.description: Jurisdiction label exactly as the source provided it.

category.description: Source taxonomy category, for example Regulations, guidelines and standards.

initiative_type.description: Instrument type from the source taxonomy.

binding.description: Legal force as stated by the source: Binding, Non-binding, or null when unstated.

status.description: Lifecycle status as stated by the source.

start_year.description: Year the initiative began, when stated.

end_year.description: Year the initiative ended, when stated.

overview.description: Long-form overview from the source, HTML stripped.

source_url.description: Official page or document URL for the initiative.

principles.description: OECD AI Principles the source tagged.

raw.description: Complete original record as fetched, kept for auditability.

first_synced.description: When the sync first stored this record.

updated_at.description: Source-side last-update time, used for delta detection; null when the source omits it.

country_scores.description: Latest scores per country: five dimensions plus the maturity composite, methodology v2 sub-indicators with their v2.1 rationales, research confidence, and evidence coverage (grounded, initiatives_used, web_search).

id.description:
Row UUID.

Note:
This is a Primary Key.<pk/>

country_id.description:
FK to countries.id; unique, one row per country.

Note:
This is a Foreign Key to `countries.id`.<fk table='countries' column='id'/>

regulation_status.description: Existence and maturity of AI-specific regulation, 1 to 5 (normative).

policy_lever.description: Breadth of policy instruments in use, 1 to 5 (normative).

governance_type.description: Where regulatory authority sits, 1 centralized to 5 distributed (descriptive; excluded from avg_score).

actor_involvement.description: Who shapes policy, 1 narrow expert circles to 5 broad participation (descriptive; excluded from avg_score).

avg_score.description: Maturity index: mean of the three normative dimensions (regulation_status, policy_lever, enforcement_level).

subscores.description: Methodology v2 audit trail: four named integer sub-indicators per dimension. The scores from subscores.json; the v2.1 rationales live in the rationales column.

confidence.description: Research confidence: high, medium, or low.

data_version.description: Per-country revision counter: 1 for the first entry, incremented on every research pass that updates the row.

run_id.description:
FK to research_runs.id: the run that produced this row.

Note:
This is a Foreign Key to `research_runs.id`.<fk table='research_runs' column='id'/>

scored_at.description: Date the country was last researched.

rationales.description: Methodology v2.1: one-sentence model rationale per sub-indicator, keyed dimension -> sub-indicator (same keys as subscores, no date). Null for countries not yet re-researched under v2.1.

grounded.description: True when the research prompt embedded at least one verified policy initiative (OECD.AI Policy Navigator / GAIIN); always equals coalesce(initiatives_used, 0) > 0, so false when initiatives_used is 0 or null. The run's model is research_runs.model via run_id. Null when the country has no run record since evidence coverage was first recorded (September 2026); initiatives_used and web_search are then null too.

initiatives_used.description: Verified policy initiatives embedded in the research prompt (capped at 15). 0 when the run consulted the evidence database and it held none for the country; null when the run did not consult it (not a grounded run) or the country has no run record.

web_search.description: True when the model had web search for the country's latest research pass. Null when the country has no run record.
